name: animora-ai-platform
description: Animora AI - Production AI Animation & Video Generation Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm --prefix client run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix functions install
